name: Nawaf
bio: I am Nawaf, a cybersecurity specialist focused on penetration testing and security assessment. I enjoy understanding how systems and web applications work, identifying potential weaknesses, and learning how to improve their security. My technical interests include exploring Linux environments, studying application behavior, and approaching security challenges through careful analysis and responsible practice. Alongside cybersecurity, I build software projects and experiment with artificial intelligence, creating practical tools and interfaces while strengthening my development skills. I value continuous learning, clear problem-solving, and attention to detail, and I aim to turn every project into an opportunity to grow as a developer and cybersecurity professional.
